csv_project_name: Planning/Design for Trail757 - Endview Multi-Use Path
csv_scope_of_work: The Virginia Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a Planning/Design for Trail757 - Endview Multi-Use Path. Trail757 (formerly known as Birthplace of America Trail - BoAT) is the centerpiece of a regional active transportation system that includes the South Hampton Roads Trail and the Virginia Capital Trail. This project supports the construction of a new multi-use path (MUP) that is ten feet wide along Yorktown Road starting at Chelsea Place up to Endview Plantation and into the Newport News park along the waterline easement to connect to the existing trails. Sources of funding for this project includes federal grants through the Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Alternatives Program (TAP).
